artifacts.measurement_provenance: Readiness and operation probes preceded the PDF position and sidebar focus fixes. Their original binary hash is retained. Markdown/EPUB full regressions and eight reflow scale cases use the shared-focus integration artifact. The final PDF-only change captures its locator synchronously at breakpoint notification. test_setup_notes: The focused-sidebar test explicitly focuses the search entry before clearing it, matching keyboard use; deleting a programmatically focused result row is a separate action
An earlier scale run exited without a complete report at its final PDF case. The final scale suite uses a fresh compositor and fixed artifact; no incomplete case is counted as passing

checks.scope: Real Orca announcement generation and keyboard input on Xvfb, with a silent Speech Dispatcher module; no human listening/usability claim

fixes.symptom: At 125% scale, reopening a long notebook stopped above its saved text
fixes.cause: GTK fractional layout updates interrupted its pending scroll animation
fixes.change: Complete restoration once at the laid-out text mark without animation; cancel on hide or new editing input
fixes.result: All 12 format/scale cases pass, including second-process restart

fixes.symptom: PDF current-passage/reference state could describe the preceding page after page turns or search navigation
fixes.cause: Papers page-change signal precedes view allocation; ordinary idle also ran before the new frame
fixes.change: Refresh position after one completed GTK layout frame, guarded by the existing restore serial; finite callback
fixes.result: Final 1200-page PDF scale matrix and full PDF flows compare against the actual visible page

fixes.symptom: Hiding the focused search sidebar in a scanned PDF displayed page 1 while the model/footer still showed page 3
fixes.cause: GTK and BreakpointBin restored focus through Papers Tab traversal, which starts at the beginning of the document. Capturing the locator later in an idle callback was racy.
fixes.change: Return focus explicitly when hiding the focused sidebar/notebook and entering Focus mode; preserve the PDF locator with the existing restore path when BreakpointBin changes orientation

timing_regression.fix: Capture and protect the locator synchronously in breakpoint notification, before its deferred focus restoration

fixes.result: The sidebar-focused minimized sequence preserves page 3. A separate Focus-mode/narrow-layout reproduction required protecting the PDF locator synchronously across BreakpointBin unmap/focus restoration; final native tests require a non-first PDF page through focus and resize
